verses.text: Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha tiknaik hanheja' yel waw yuj in ya'elal tik. Wach'chom tzin te k'akwi, palta hanheja' yak'anoch in ya'elal Dios.
Komonok swojtakejeli b'ajtil tz'ilchaj Dios chi' wu'uj, tas pax tz'aj in k'och b'aj ay sdespacho.
Tato icha chi' tzam wal t'ay yuj in ya'elal tik, yujto tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ay yuj in kolan in b'a.
Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas ol yal t'ayin.
¿Tokwal ol yak'lab'ej yip yik tzin skachanem numnajok? Ma'ay, ol smaklej yab' tas ol wala'.
Ol am yojtakejeli to yel swala', ol am yalani to malaj in mul. Icham chi' ol aj in yak'anel t'a libre t'a junelnhej.
Tzin sayek' Dios t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, malaj ayek' ta'. Tzin saypaxek' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, max ilchajpaxlaj wuj ta'.
Tzin sayek' t'a stojolal norte, max ilchajlaj wu'uj. Hanhejtona', tzin sayanxi t'a stojolal sur, max sch'ox pax sb'a t'ayin ta'.
Palta yojtak in b'eyb'al. Ayik ol lajwok in yak'an prowal, wach'xonhej ol in ajkan icha k'e'en oro sb'o t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha jun b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan t'ayin, malaj b'ak'inh swaktejkan in b'eyb'alani.
Tzin k'anab'ajejnhej scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al. Ek'b'alxo yelk'och scheknab'il chi' t'a yichanh b'eyumal t'a yol in sat.
Ayik sna'an Dios sk'ulan junok tasi, sk'ulejnhej, malaj junok mach syal skachanoch wa'an.
Ha tas nab'il yuj sk'ulan t'ayin, sk'ulejnhej. Tzijtumto pax tas nab'il yuj t'a wib'anh.
Yuj wal chi' tzin te xiw t'ay. Anhej tzin na'ankoti tzin te xiwk'ei.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, yuj tz'el wip yuj xiwelal.
Wach'chom maxtzak wil-laj yuj k'ik' k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik, palta max in emlaj numan.
